jobs.title: Director, Marketing
jobs.description:
About Cala

At Cala, we’re working to free people from the burden of chronic disease. We began by creating the first non-invasive prescription therapy for hand tremor. After years of careful fine-tuning and improvements, we recently released kIQ® Plus, our most sophisticated therapy yet. Our products have empowered thousands of people to get back to their lives with confidence and ease.

But we won’t stop there. Our pioneering technology can be applied across neurology, cardiology, and beyond. It’s all part of our mission to help people in their struggle with chronic disease. We’re only just getting started

The Opportunity

Cala Health is seeking a Director of Marketing to join our team. The role will report to the Vice President of Marketing and will have direct reports.  The Director of Marketing will lead the development and execution of marketing strategies to drive adoption, penetration, and revenue growth. This role will drive commercial planning and integrated marketing campaigns for market leadership and to accelerate growth.  The Director will work closely with cross functions, including Upstream Product Marketing, Customer facing functions, R&D, Regulatory and Legal to consistently deliver high-impact programs and solutions.

Title: Director, Marketing
Reports to: VP, Marketing
Location:  Hybrid in San Mateo, CA 3 days per week (Local candidates only)
Employment type: Full-Time, Exempt
Pay range:  $170,000 - $220,000
Travel Expectations : Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.

A Day in the Life

- Lead the execution of commercial strategic plans  t o drive revenue, profitability, and overall company objectives.

- Define and shape go-to-market strategies , encompassing product, process, and customer journey initiatives.

- Spearhead comprehensive commercial launch plans , including positioning, messaging, branding, evidence strategies, and KOL engagement.

- Drive market awareness and adoption  by identifying growth opportunities and gathering insights that align with patient and provider needs.

- Manage integrated marketing channels  (digital, conferences, social media, etc.) and oversee vendor partnerships to maximize reach and ROI.

- Engage regularly in the field  to build relationships with key physicians and sales leadership, gaining critical market insights to drive innovation.

- Lead, coach, and develop  a high-performing team while defining and tracking key KPIs to measure engagement, preference, and retention.

Skills and Experience

Required:

- 10+ years of marketing experience in FDA regulated product management and commercialization.

- Downstream marketing in medical device, diagnostics or related field,

- DME experience a plus.

- Bachelor’s degree required in Science or Engineering,

- MBA preferred.

- Previous Management experience required.

- Forward-thinking and highly analytical mindset with a track record of inspiring teams and driving cross-functional alignment.

- Proven ability to translate long-term commercial vision into structured, actionable plans that deliver business results.

- Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving results in a fast-paced, evolving landscape.

- Outstanding communication, organization collaboration.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis, or eligible for work authorization through a sponsorship path that Cala Health is able to support. Sponsorship decisions are made individually based on role, timeline, and cost considerations, and are not guaranteed.

Cala Health believes our success is based on diversity of people, teams and thinking. We offer all employees the tools, training and mentoring they need to succeed. Our selection process is driven by the key requirements for the role rather than bias or discrimination on the basis of a candidate’s sex, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, non-jobrelated disability/handicap or medical condition, family status, sexual orientation, religion, color, ethnicity, race or any other legally protected classification.

But we won’t stop there. Our pioneering technology can be applied across neurology, cardiology, and beyond. It’s all part of our mission to help people in their struggle with chronic disease. We’re only just getting started

Title:  Manager, Compliance and Contracts

Reports to:  General Counsel

Location:  San Mateo, CA

Employment Type:  Full-time, Exempt

Pay Range:  $125,000 - $160,000

**Final compensation is based on experience, skills, market benchmarks, and internal equity, with potential adjustments for candidate location. **

The Opportunity

The Manager, Compliance and Contracts is responsible for managing all Durable Medical Equipment licenses and overseeing, managing, and coordinating the company's contracts. They will work with the General Counsel to ensuring that the company's operations and procedures comply with legal regulations and internal policies. The role requires a high level of independence and effective collaboration with colleagues across various departments, including sales & marketing, research & development, clinical, business systems and more.

Specific Responsibilities

Compliance

- Manage all Durable Medical Equipment licenses and CMS enrollment

- Work with General Counsel to develop, implement, and manage effective compliance programs to ensure the company's operations and procedures comply with all legal regulations and internal policies.

- Maintain compliance calendars and coordinate responses to auditors and regulators.

- Monitor company procedures and ensure adherence to compliance standards.

- Provide training and guidance to company employees regarding new regulations and compliance measures.

Contracts

- Oversee, manage, and coordinate all aspects of the company's contracts. Track renewals, expirations, and contractual obligations

- Ensure compliance with legal requirements and company policies in all contract matters.

- Manage contract creation, execution, and analysis to maximize operational and financial performance.

- Provide guidance on terms and conditions. Provide support for contract negotiations.

- Identify potential risks associated with contracts and propose creative solutions to mitigate them.

- Collaborate effectively with colleagues across various departments to ensure contract alignment with company objectives.

- Provide guidance and support to the team on all contract-related matters.

Skills and Experience

Minimum Qualifications

- Associate’s or Bachelor's degree; Paralegal certificate preferred.

- 5+ years corporate paralegal experience.

- Experience in contracts, corporate governance and compliance preferred.

- Strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent communication skills.

- Ability to work independently with limited guidance.

Preferred Qualifications

- Paralegal certificate.

- Certification in Contract Management.

- Experience in healthcare and MedTech.

- Knowledge of DME or MedTech industry laws and regulations.

- Proven track record of managing complex contracts and achieving financial or operational improvements.

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with colleagues and provide clear guidance to team members.
